Moxi, the hospital robot created by Diligent Robotics

Care is a team effort

Moxi helps clinical staff do more in less time. Routine activities completed with ease through automation by Moxi.

CONTACT US
 

Moxi helps hospitals run 24/7 by assisting clinical staff with non-patient-facing tasks like: 

  • Running patient supplies 

  • Delivering lab samples 

  • Fetching items from central supply 

  • Distributing PPE

  • Delivering medications

 

 Moxi’s software means it’s simple to dynamically add new activities as your staff’s needs change.

In the initial set-up, Moxi is joined by Diligent’s implementation team that can add any number of operational workflows customized for your workspace. 

Automation helps hospitals and clinical staff work smarter, not harder

Your hospital functions better with Moxi

Give Back Time

Nurses spend up to 30% of their time on non-value added tasks

Support Current Staff

The demand for nurses is surging, but supply is not growing fast enough (2.7M (2014), 3.2M (2024))

Helps Retain Staff
